items.title: 56800_John Simmons oral history interview
items.q: And then there were other bands, like I made notes on them, but I didn't bring them with me, that was traveling with the vaudeville shows, you know, like the Whitman Sisters, and Bessie Smith's entourage, and Ma Rainey and her Rabbit Foot Show, you know.

ctx.x: Oh, yeah, yeah, I remember. Bands that I've mentioned here on the tape, prior to this, bands like Effie Jackson, Tommy Douglas, Benny Moten, Georgie Lee, Pee Wee Towles, Holder, Alphonso Trent, Clyde Love and Clouds of Joy, Nat Towles, -- that's one that I had forgotten, out of Nebraska. Lloyd Hunter, out of Denver. Just all the bands that was barnstorming,

they always made Tulsa. And then there were other bands, like I made notes on them, but I didn't bring them with me, that was traveling with the vaudeville shows, you know, like the Whitman Sisters, and Bessie Smith's entourage, and Ma Rainey and her Rabbit Foot Show, you know. Yeah. Like, they had a bunch of female singers during that time that I can relate to.
